submission.natural_language_explanation: L15/N1604+ fires retrospectively on a token that is the conventional, high-expectancy completion of the frame its prefix sets up — a stock collocate, boilerplate slot-filler, parallel repeat, or formulaic opener (degrees->Celsius, password-rule one->number, The->patient/capital/cat, wrote->Hamlet, list->are) — and drops when the same slot takes an unexpected word or the licensing frame is removed, even with the peak token itself unchanged. Only the prefix and the peak token matter, so edits after the peak leave its activation unchanged.
